description: A style change applies at once under reduced motion, with no transition left running. The page /reduced-motion/transition is a phone-width page with every stylesheet the server ships and a rule ".box { width: 50px; transition: width 1s; }". "The probe" is this eval, which builds a fresh box each time and so can run again safely: const b = document.body.appendChild(Object.assign(document.createElement('div'), { className: 'box' })); getComputedStyle(b).width; b.style.width = '77px'; const r = getComputedStyle(b).width + ' ' + b.getAnimations().length; b.remove(); r. 1. Navigate to /reduced-motion/transition. 2. Eval [...document.querySelectorAll('link[rel="stylesheet"]')].every((l) => l.sheet && l.sheet.cssRules.length > 0): it must return true (allow 15s): every shipped stylesheet loaded. 3. Run the probe: it must return exactly "77px 0" (the new width, and no transition). 4. The probe can tell: emulate prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference, and the probe must now return exactly "50px 1" (the old width, held by a running transition).
